speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to help identify the cause, have you noticed any rash or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. The consumption of ice cream three days prior to the onset of your symptoms is a significant clue; did this ice cream contain unpasteurized milk or soft cheeses? Also, please confirm if you have noticed any abdominal pain or contractions.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The history of unpasteurized dairy consumption three days before symptom onset in a pregnant patient with fever, headache, and flu-like symptoms is classic for this diagnosis. I am not requesting further tests as the clinical picture is diagnostic.
